sources.title: Ведомости Съезда народных депутатов СССР и Верховного Совета СССР — официальное печатное издание
sources.coverage: Official USSR laws, decrees and resolutions published in the 1991 gazette; the web host is an unofficial electronic reproduction of the official printed issues
sources.notes: Canonical citation must refer to the original printed Vedomosti issue/article, not treat the web transcription itself as an official host. For Baltic recognition use 1991 No. 37, arts. 1091–1093, resolutions GS-1, GS-2 and GS-3 of 6 September 1991.
